capabilities: Convert @ YYYY-MM-DD date references into relative date elements
Color-code dates by urgency (overdue, today, tomorrow, this week, future)
Customize the @ prefix and colors in settings
Open or create a daily note by clicking a date
Render in both Reading mode and Live Preview
extras: Manifest note: this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation section covers both GitHub release download and building from source.
problem: Raw absolute dates like 2025-08-12 in task lists are hard to scan for urgency, showing no indication of how far away a due date is.

relations.evidence: Click on any relative date to open or create a daily note for that day (uses the settings of Daily Notes core plugin)

summary: Plugin that converts @-prefixed date references in task lists into color-coded relative dates with clickable daily-note links.
